title: Agent coordination and task decomposition
abstract: How multi-step tasks should be split between deterministic workflow steps and model-driven decisions. The open question is not whether an agent can complete a task, but whether its failure modes are observable and recoverable.

title: Document understanding for operational records
abstract: Extraction accuracy on real business documents: purchase orders, quotations and specification sheets. Focus areas are table structure, unit handling and the validation step that decides whether an extracted value is safe to use.

title: Evaluation methods for production AI systems
abstract: Benchmark scores rarely predict behaviour on a specific business process. This work examines task-specific evaluation sets, confidence calibration and the review thresholds that decide when a human must confirm an output.

title: When to use rules and when to use models
abstract: A decision framework for workflow design. Deterministic logic is cheaper, faster and easier to audit; models handle variation and ambiguity. Most production systems need both, and the boundary between them is the design decision that matters.
